tickets.title: Compare current adjustable mortgage against fixed-rate and shorter-term refinance quotes
tickets.text: Prepare a side-by-side review of the current adjustable mortgage against fixed-rate and shorter-term refinance quotes, including closing costs, monthly payment impact, and the point at which refinancing would offset upfront costs. Use Liora Nettlewhisk’s mortgage balance of about $742,000, HELOC balance of about $96,000, and the rate reset scheduled for 2025.
tickets.evidence: Liora asked for a side-by-side review of the current adjustable mortgage against fixed-rate and shorter-term refinance quotes, including closing costs, monthly payment impact, and the point at which refinancing would offset upfront costs; the agreed follow-up is due 2025-06-03.

tickets.title: Analyze mortgage reset timing and recommend refinance decision window
tickets.text: Provide a recommendation early enough for Liora Nettlewhisk to decide whether to lock a refinance quote or remain with the current lender, using the mortgage servicer’s notice showing the upcoming rate change window.
tickets.evidence: the mortgage servicer’s notice shows an upcoming rate change window, and the household wants a recommendation early enough to decide whether to lock a refinance quote or remain with the current lender; the agreed follow-up is due 2025-05-30.

tickets.title: Collect missing HELOC document pages
tickets.text: Obtain the missing HELOC statement pages including margin, draw-period terms, and repayment conversion language from the portal or servicer, so the advisory team can model the combined debt picture for Liora Nettlewhisk.
tickets.evidence: the portal file contains only a partial HELOC statement, and the missing pages include the margin, draw-period terms, and repayment conversion language needed to model the combined debt picture; the agreed follow-up is due 2025-05-20.

tickets.title: Review cash-flow discrepancy between escrow estimate and household budget
tickets.text: Reconcile the difference between the mortgage servicer’s escrow estimate and Liora Nettlewhisk’s household budget for monthly property tax and insurance amounts, and update the projected payment after the loan reset.
tickets.evidence: the mortgage servicer’s escrow estimate and Liora’s household budget show different monthly property tax and insurance amounts, creating uncertainty in the projected payment after the loan reset; the agreed follow-up is due 2025-05-27.

tickets.title: Investigate and resolve Teacup Comet Bank autopay double-draft issue
tickets.text: Investigate why Teacup Comet Bank drafted the HELOC autopay twice in one cycle, and implement safeguards to protect the checking account cushion before payroll posts.
tickets.evidence: Liora reported that Teacup Comet Bank drafted the HELOC autopay twice in one cycle, temporarily reducing the checking account cushion and forcing a transfer from savings before payroll posted; the agreed follow-up is due 2025-05-21.

tickets.title: Assess debt repayment funding using share sales
tickets.text: Review the tax and concentration implications of selling Cloudberry Kite Robotics shares to pay off the credit card balance and part of the auto loan, given the varying tax lots and unrealized gains.
tickets.evidence: a portfolio review showed that selling enough Cloudberry Kite Robotics shares to pay off the credit card balance and part of the auto loan could reduce concentration risk, but the tax lots vary significantly by holding period and unrealized gain; the agreed follow-up is due 2025-06-10.
